hooks.name: H4 Guardrails on the decision layer
hooks.description: The five guardrails this project cannot breach: no establishment identifier in any illness-derived output (the FSIS licence forbids associating samples with illness), no safety verdict on any food or plant, a synthetic flag on every pounds-denominated payload, reversal evidence and human confirmation on every high-consequence recommendation, and recalls sorted above model scores. The spec asked for this on commit; Kiro has no git-commit trigger, so it runs on edit instead, which is strictly earlier and therefore safer.
